verdict.rationale: Docs reference an enterprise 'GPTs and sharing' feature where GPT builders can configure actions and approved apps for custom assistants, implying the classic Custom GPT builder capability exists, but the evidence pack never explicitly describes adding custom instructions or uploading a knowledge base, nor sharing flows to other users. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of instructions/knowledge upload for a custom GPT, evidence of public/team sharing mechanics, and independent user reports confirming the workflow.
